name: base_jp-mcp
display_name: BASE (store platform) + BASE Developers API + BASE Apps supplier connectors MCP
description: BASE (store platform) + BASE Developers API + BASE Apps supplier connectors (ecommerce suppliers): m

platform_mcp_base_jp_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BASE_JP_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_base_jp_client_id.description: Client ID of your app at https://developers.thebase.in/ (API application required).

platform_mcp_base_jp_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BASE_JP_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_base_jp_client_secret.description: Client secret of the same app.

platform_mcp_base_jp_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BASE_JP_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_base_jp_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from the one-time authorization-code exchange (GET /1/oauth/authorize with scope read_users read_items read_orders → POST /1/oauth/token, https://docs.thebase.in/api/oauth/access_token). Valid about 30 days and rotated on every refresh; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the rotated token survives restarts.

platform_mcp_base_jp_redirect_uri.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BASE_JP_REDIRECT_URI
platform_mcp_base_jp_redirect_uri.description: The callback URL registered for your BASE Developers app; BASE requires it in every refresh-token request ('redirect_uri 登録したコールバックURL (必須)', https://docs.thebase.in/api/oauth/refresh_token).

tools.name: me
tools.description: The connected shop: {user: {shop_id, shop_name, shop_url, …}} (scope read_users).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Items of the CONNECTED BASE SHOP (GET /1/items, scope read_items), in list_order; `category` is a BASE category_id. BASE is a storefront platform, so these are the merchant's own products, not a supplier catalogue; keyword search is not applied (GET /1/items/search needs its own q).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One item of the connected shop (GET /1/items/detail/:item_id); variations[{variation_id, variation, variation_stock, variation_identifier}] are in `raw`.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: An order received by the connected shop (GET /1/orders/detail/:unique_key, scope read_orders). dispatch_status: unshippable, ordered (未対応), unpaid, shipping, dispatched, cancelled; `created_at` is epoch seconds; order_items and order_receiver are in `raw`.
